description: Slot-independent labware GEOMETRY. Where a piece of labware sits is in layout.json, never here. A rack has the same internal geometry regardless of which slot it occupies.

grid_models.pitch: anchor well (row 0, col 0) + pitch + integer direction vectors. Placement supplies the anchor.
grid_models.corners: three measured well centres (origin, along_col, along_row) solved for pitch and rotation. Placement supplies the corners. Use when the real pitch differs from nominal.
grid_models.a1_from_slot_edge: For slot-mounted labware whose first position is dimensioned from the LOCATION edges rather than from a measured machine coordinate. Names which edge each inset is taken from and how far in. The location cell is the slot centre expanded by half the slot pitch, so 135.5 x 93.25 mm here.

grid.direction_note: Increasing COLUMN index moves toward LOWER X. Increasing ROW index moves toward LOWER Y. This is the OPPOSITE column sense from tiprack_300_96 - do not hardcode one convention globally.
grid.source: X_PITCH=12 / Y_PITCH=18 / ROWS=5 / COLS=10 in examples/300ulaccuracyprecision.py, examples/125accuracyprecision.py and examples/PipetteCurve15.py; independently cross-checked against the hardcoded Xlist=range(78,187,12), Ylist=range(223,150,-18) in examples/PipetteCurve.py and against the emitted coordinates in 300ulPipetteAccuracy.gcode. Pitch confirmed by operator 2026-08-25.

z.note: Absolute Z is effector-dependent (a fitted tip hangs below the nosecone), so the working Z lives in effectors/*.json under z_for_labware. These nominal fields stay null until z_stage_surface is measured.
z.top_note: Superseded by height_mm: a physical height above the stage is frame- and effector-independent, so the commanded-Z limit is derived per effector instead of stored.

wipe.description: Wall wipe: step sideways to contact the inner wall, drag the droplet UP (-Z), then pull back off the wall. dx must be less than the tube inner radius.

tube_rack_0p65_5x10.height_note: Physical height of the EMPTY holder above the stage. With tubes and caps in it the effective height is greater by an unmeasured amount - see height_with_contents_mm.
tube_rack_0p65_5x10.height_with_contents_note: UNMEASURED. Anything taller than 57.5 mm is struck at travel height with a 300 uL tip fitted (stage 114.75 - tip 52.25 - travel 5.0), so this holder has 22.5 mm of headroom for tubes and caps before travel height stops being safe.
tube_rack_0p65_5x10.approach_order_note: Y FIRST, then X. The tube caps make Y motion over this holder difficult, so the effector must reach its Y position while still clear of the holder in X, then come in along X. X motion passes between cap rows and is fine; Y motion crosses them. Operator instruction 2026-08-26. lab/machine.py honours this per-labware; the keep-out router can still override it, and says so when it does.

grid.direction_note: Solved from the three measured corners in layout.json. Increasing COLUMN index moves toward HIGHER X; increasing ROW index moves toward LOWER Y. Real pitch is ~9.09 x ~9.10, NOT the nominal 9.00 - assuming 9.00 accumulates ~1.0 mm by column 12, enough to miss a tip.
grid.a1_corner_note: The three corners define the grid unambiguously, but which corner is A1 does NOT follow from them. Confirm before trusting well names in the manifest.

tip.length_note: DERIVED, not measured directly: deck z.stage_surface 114.75 (bare p300 nosecone on the stage) minus z.stage_surface_with_p300_tip 62.5 (same stage, tip fitted). Nosecone reference to tip orifice.

consume_order.exit_edge_note: After pickup the effector CANNOT pass over occupied tip positions - it shears the tip off. The first move after pickup must be in X. The X exit crosses every position between the picked column and the box edge, so columns must be consumed starting nearest the exit edge. The box spans X 18-118; whether the exit is toward X 18 or X 118 is UNCONFIRMED.
consume_order.policy_note: Implemented by Machine._next_free_tip_col: the first unused column working inward from exit_edge.

sbs_96_wellplate.grid_centered_note: 14.38 + 11*9/2 = 63.88 = 127.76/2 and 11.24 + 7*9/2 = 42.74 = 85.48/2, so A1-from-centre is derivable from the grid span. Placement may still override with a1_from_center.

z.note: Working and crash depths are per-effector and live in effectors/*.json -> z_for_labware, because the commanded Z at which a tip reaches a well floor depends on the tip. For p300 with a 300 uL tip: work 53.5, bottom 60.8.

sbs_96_wellplate.note: Not used by any current protocol. Included as a standard definition.
sbs_96_wellplate.height_note: UNMEASURED. Physical height of the plate above the stage. Without it Simulator.labware_top_z cannot convert to a commanded Z, so traverse clearance over the plates reports 'cannot check' rather than passing. Anything taller than 57.5 mm is struck at travel height with a 300 uL tip.
sbs_96_wellplate.approach_order_note: Deliberately unset, so the default X-first applies. A plate has no caps, so the Y-first rule the tube holders need does not apply here.

z.top_note: Unmeasured. Note that deck z.slot_edge_with_p300_tip (53.0) is currently the binding traverse constraint - the raised location edges. This rim only matters if the labware stands HIGHER than those edges, i.e. would be hit at a Z below 53 with a tip fitted.

grid.rows_cols_note: INFERRED, not stated - CONFIRM. The operator gave the A1 position and the pitches but not the counts. From the calibrated A1 at (252.50, 305.50) in slot 5: a 7th column would sit at X 132.50, which is 0.25 mm inside the location's low-X edge (132.25), so an ~11 mm tube there would overhang into slot 6 by 5.25 mm. 6 columns leaves the last one 20.25 mm inside the edge, which is physically sensible. 3 rows fit with 20.12 mm to spare at the bottom. 6 is chosen as the FAIL-SAFE: if the holder really has 7, asking for column 6 raises a clear IndexError, whereas the reverse mistake would drive a tip into empty space over the slot boundary. Column X: 252.5, 232.5, 212.5, 192.5, 172.5, 152.5. Row Y: 305.5, 275.5, 245.5.
grid.direction_note: Same sense as the 0.65 mL holder: column index toward LOWER X, row index toward LOWER Y.
grid.source: Operator 2026-08-26: columns 20 mm apart, rows 30 mm apart.

a1_from_slot_edge.note: CALIBRATED from a direct measurement, not from the verbal description. The operator measured A1 of this holder in slot 5 as (252.50, 305.50) on 2026-08-27; against slot 5's cell (centre 200, 272 expanded by half the slot pitch 135.5 x 93.25) that is 15.25 mm in from the high-X edge and 13.125 mm down from the top edge. The original description was '13 mm down from the top and 14 mm in from the very left', which predicted (253.75, 305.625) - right to 0.125 mm in Y and 1.25 mm out in X. That measurement also CONFIRMS 'the very left' means the HIGH-X edge: the low-X reading would have put A1 at X 146.25, 106 mm away.
a1_from_slot_edge.caveat: These insets were calibrated in SLOT 5. The slot X pitch is irregular (136 between slots 1-2 and 135 between 2-3, mean 135.5), so a cell derived from the mean pitch is up to 0.5 mm out in other slots. Re-measure A1 if this holder is moved rather than trusting the model to transfer exactly.

tube_rack_1p5.height_note: Empty holder, above the stage. Leaves 12.5 mm of headroom for tubes and caps before travel height (Z 5 with a 300 uL tip) stops clearing it.
tube_rack_1p5.approach_order_note: Y first then X, same as the 0.65 mL holder and for the same reason: caps make Y motion across the holder difficult. Operator instruction 2026-08-26.
